title: NR Sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions

entities.name: NR Sidelink U2N Remote UE threshold conditions
entities.description: Threshold conditions that determine when a UE capable of NR sidelink U2N Remote UE operation should consider the conditions met (entry) or not met (leave).

entities.name: threshHighRemote
entities.description: A configured threshold parameter for RSRP measurement comparison.

entities.name: hystMaxRemote
entities.description: A configured hysteresis parameter applied to threshHighRemote for threshold comparison.

entities.name: RSRP measurement
entities.description: Reference Signal Received Power measurement of the PCell or the cell on which the UE camps.

entities.name: suitable cell
entities.description: Condition indicating whether the UE has a suitable cell to camp on.

entities.name: Entry condition
entities.description: Condition that triggers the UE to consider threshold conditions met.

entities.name: Leave condition
entities.description: Condition that triggers the UE to consider threshold conditions not met.

relations.description: Threshold conditions are guarded by the threshHighRemote parameter.
Threshold conditions are guarded by the hystMaxRemote hysteresis parameter.
Threshold conditions are guarded by RSRP measurement of the PCell or camping cell.
Threshold conditions are guarded by the presence of a suitable cell.
Entry condition establishes that threshold conditions are met.
Leave condition establishes that threshold conditions are not met.
